description: Whether monitoring itself is working, stage by stage: scrape and store, evaluate and notify, collect and store logs. Every failure shown here also has an alert; use this dashboard to diagnose one and to confirm health after a change.

panels.description: Webhook deliveries from Alertmanager in the last 10 minutes, excluding failed attempts; healthchecks.io is the only webhook receiver. Expect about 5, one every two minutes. healthchecks.io pages if none arrives for 10 minutes.
panels.title: Watchdog heartbeats delivered (10 min)

panels.description: Failed Alertmanager deliveries to any integration in the last hour. Expect 0.
panels.title: Notification failures (1 h)

panels.description: Critical and warning alerts currently firing; both route to Pushover. Shows no data when vmalert's always-firing Watchdog is missing, because then vmalert is not evaluating.
panels.title: Alerts firing

panels.description: Silenced alerts do not notify. Never silence Watchdog: healthchecks.io pages after about 10 minutes.
panels.title: Active silences

panels.description: vmagent scrape targets whose last scrape failed; the Scrape targets down table names them. Shows no data when no scrape results arrive at all.
panels.title: Scrape targets down

panels.description: Rows VictoriaLogs received through native ingestion in the last 10 minutes, including any it then rejected (see Log loss). 0 means log collection or ingestion has stopped; VictoriaLogsIngestionSilent fires after 15 minutes.
panels.title: Log rows received (10 min)
Scrape targets down
panels.description: Targets whose most recent scrape failed.
Rows VMSingle inserted per second, across all ingestion paths.
panels.title: Samples ingested per second

panels.description: Bytes the cluster vmagent has scraped but not yet delivered to VMSingle. Expect 0; a growing queue means VMSingle is not accepting writes.
panels.title: vmagent send queue

panels.description: Series VMSingle created for the first time. Pod restarts and rollouts cause short bursts; a sustained rise means label churn.
panels.title: New series per minute

panels.description: Share of inserted rows that missed VMSingle's series cache, over 5 minutes: TooHighSlowInsertsRate's expression. The line marks its 5% threshold, which must hold for 15 minutes to fire.
panels.title: Slow inserts

panels.description: Free space on the VMSingle and VictoriaLogs volumes. The line marks VictoriaLogsDiskSpaceLow's 10% threshold.
panels.title: Storage free space

panels.description: Errors per interval. Expect all four at 0.
panels.title: vmalert errors

panels.description: Firing alerts, excluding Watchdog and InfoInhibitor. Info alerts are not delivered.
panels.title: Alerts firing by severity

panels.description: Alertmanager notifications per interval for each integration that has attempted one; delivered excludes failed attempts. webhook is the Watchdog heartbeat to healthchecks.io; pushover is paging.
panels.title: Notifications delivered and failed

targets.expr: (sum by (integration) (increase(alertmanager_notifications_total[$__interval])) - sum by (integration) (increase(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total[$__interval]))) and on (integration) (sum by (integration) (alertmanager_notifications_total) > 0)

panels.description: Rows vlagent read from container logs on each node, and rows VictoriaLogs received. Received should track the sum of collected.
panels.title: Log rows per second

panels.description: Bytes waiting in each node's persistent queue for VictoriaLogs. The line marks VlagentBufferNearCapacity at 3 GiB of the 4 GiB budget.
panels.title: vlagent queue per node

panels.description: Log data lost per interval, by pipeline stage and reason. Expect nothing above 0.
panels.title: Log loss

title: Observability / Pipeline
